purpose: Provide one fail-closed, deterministic decision seam for skills, traversal, portals, encounters, challenges, and persistent anchors.

authority.blueprint_role: request evaluation, present result, and route to the owning native authority

evaluation_input.request_id_policy: stable per attempted action; duplicate evaluation is read-only and replay-safe
evaluation_input.preview_policy: preview may explain a missing or blocked requirement but never grants capability or mutates state

evaluation_result.fingerprint_policy: hash the normalized input and resolved provider/progression/context values; do not fingerprint presentation-only state

content_kind_routes.skill: evaluate capability/context/progression, then request stock battle execution
content_kind_routes.enemy: evaluate encounter availability; stock battle unit owns execution and defeat
content_kind_routes.encounter: evaluate availability and lock state, then request battle authority
content_kind_routes.portal: evaluate capability/progression/context, then request save-before-travel through UMelodiaTravelSubsystem
content_kind_routes.traversal: evaluate capability/context, then request mode transition through UMelodiaTraversalComponent
content_kind_routes.world_challenge: evaluate availability, then submit completion/reward intent to canonical progression
content_kind_routes.state_anchor: evaluate canonical state and apply once through the save/narrative contract

allowed: display allowed, blocked, or preview-only state
offer an authored fallback or alternate route
forward an allowed request to its named authority
forbidden: mutate movement, battle, travel, reward, or save state from a gate
cache an allow decision across a context/progression/load transition
treat a preview as an executable grant
use presentation variant selection as capability ownership

offline: all seven canonical content kinds reference this contract
missing-provider and unknown-capability paths are fail-closed
evaluation fingerprint inputs are stable and presentation-independent
fixture routes declare re-evaluation and reset coverage
live_required_before_promotion: provider registration and Blueprint reflection are verified in a clean editor build
allowed and blocked context matrix produces the declared native route
load/travel/reset re-evaluation produces no stale grant
each promoted Blueprint records the gate fingerprint in fresh evidence
